## Checklist / Kontrol listesi

- [ ] Branch is off `main` and named `feat|fix|chore|docs/...`
- [ ] `cd backend && npm test && npm run build` passes (if backend touched)
- [ ] `cd frontend && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build` passes (if frontend touched)
- [ ] Schema change includes a Prisma migration (`npm run prisma:migrate`)
- [ ] Both personas (`STUDENT` / `LIFELONG_LEARNER`) considered, if user-facing
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or `.env` values committed
- [ ] Docs / comments updated where needed
